summary: JBDI Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Notice of Annual General Meeting of Members for May 28, 2026. Routine agenda includes approval of a 1-for-2 reverse stock split (optional by board within 12 months), election of five directors, and ratification of auditor OneStop Assurance PAC. This is a standard proxy statement for an annual meeting; no special situation event such as an acquisition, activist campaign, or restructuring is present. The filing is a non-US foreign issuer report.
